headline: Uzbekistan searches for gas – 5 new deposits discovered since the start of the year
summary: Uzbekistan has discovered five new gas-condensate deposits since the start of 2026. The country has nonetheless seen a noticeable decline in its own natural gas production.
why: Uzbekistan is a significant gas producer in Central Asia, and its output shapes regional gas supply and export availability. Changes in its production affect energy balances in neighbouring markets.
